meta.title: OpenGauge model and dataset supply snapshot

sources.storedExtractScope: Organization aggregates only; users/personal-account section omitted after retrieval.

quality.text: HF public model repositories cover many tasks and sizes. Repository counts are not model-family counts, distinct developers or confirmed open-source models.
Country is organization-account geographic classification. Do not interpret it as contributor nationality, all-country contribution or corporate ultimate ownership.
Geography has 826 mapped organization accounts vs overview API orgs=753; scopes differ. Use geography denominator for country comparisons; never combine these counts.

Datasets use the same 826 organizations as models. All 570 accounts with datasets also have models. This is dataset supply within a mapped model-publisher cohort, not exhaustive dataset-publisher coverage.
63 country entries include 11 with zero mapped organizations. Zero means no mapped organization in this sample, not no supply/activity.
Geography UI labels downloads cumulative all-time and likes cumulative. Downloads are retrieval counts, not distinct users, deployments or capability.
Geography UI labels *_month_change monthly growth and *_year_change annual growth; exact boundaries/base dates are absent. Preserve names; do not use them to synthesize 6/12/18-month histories.
Global monthly-new series ends July 2026 while summary last_updated is 2026-10-16. Do not fill August–October with zero or append summary as a trend point. Latest-month completeness is undocumented.
Monthly trend download zeros are not documented and coverage is uneven; omitted from canonical trend to avoid misreading missing observations as no downloads.
Organization means a Hugging Face account; sibling accounts are not merged into corporate groups. Account concentration must be labeled accordingly.

CN mapped province rows cover 135 of 147 organizations; 12 organizations lack provincial assignment. Preserve national aggregate and a distinct unassigned category. Unmapped provinces show missing/coverage status, not zero ecosystem.
Both distribution endpoints return 50 category rows, possibly truncated. Dataset task labels may overlap. Do not calculate unlabelled repository count by subtracting task-tag sums from totals.

models.taskTagScope: API returns 50 rows; cannot assume complete coverage or unique/mutually exclusive dataset labels.

datasets.taskTagScope: API returns 50 rows; cannot assume complete coverage or unique/mutually exclusive dataset labels.
